_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Environmental Compliance Report
summary: The Environmental Compliance Report documents Contractor material usage at Naval Facilities to demonstrate compliance with environmental law.
use_relationship:
This DID will report the material usage at Naval Facilities to identify that the Contractor is operating in compliance with environmental law.
This DID contains the format content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following items based upon category of the material:

children.title: Paint, solvent, adhesive, and nonskid usage records shall include the following:
Product manufacturer, identification and color
Net daily paint usage in gallons, paint application method (airless spray, HVLP, brush/roller) per paint type
Amount of paint disposed as hazardous waste
Density of mixed paint
Net daily onsite solvent usage in gallons used for equipment cleaning and surface preparation
Net amount of adhesives in unit of measure (ounces, quart, gallons or pound)
Product material safety data sheet (MSDS)
Technical data sheet
VOC certification for paint and nonskid product
Government site location
Applicable local Air Pollution Control District (APCD) permit number
Date, and ship's name
The report shall include the abrasive blast grit materials used and shall specify the following:
Manufacturer of abrasive blast grit and MSDS
Abrasive blast grit usage certification
Amount and hourly usage of the abrasive blast grit
Permit associated with the abrasive blasting equipment
The report shall include welding operation information and shall specify the following:
Welding rod manufacturer
Specific product used in welding application
MSDS
Usage in pounds
Type of welding application
The report shall identify the portable internal combustion (IC) engine greater than 50 Brake horsepower operation information and shall also include:
Amount of fuel used in gallons and the hours of operation
IC engine permit number and site location
